scope: Single-observation visual baseline only. Frozen DINOv2-S/14 and DINOv2-B/14; independently trained linear heads. No backbone training, no integrator, no CEE.

dataset.name: ImageNet-1k
dataset.selection_split: 50 per class held out from train, stratified, seed 17
dataset.fingerprint: relative path + file size + label manifest hash

acceptance.primary: mean official-val top-1 across the three seeds >= 0.80 for each backbone
secondary: reproducible final checkpoint and prediction artifact
acceptance.failure_rule: If either backbone fails the primary or seed-floor rule, report FAIL; do not tune on official validation.

rolling_state: deterministic epoch permutation seed and next-batch index
durability.resume_rule: Never restart from epoch zero when a verified rolling checkpoint exists; abort on inaccessible or inconsistent remote state.
